items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF.
Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled out with ankle injury.
items.opportunity: Targets to Jordan Addison and remaining MIN pass-catchers.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off and ruled out with rib injury/strain.
items.why: Carted mid-game; rib strain, eval Monday.
items.implication: Painful injury; SF WR depth elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining SF WRs like Deebo.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury.
items.why: Thigh injury after tackle in 4th quarter.
items.implication: Monitor severity for Week 4; Allen lead back remainder/next.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs due to knee injury.
items.why: Knee injury; coach Hafley not optimistic on severity.
items.implication: Major absence; check Week 4 status closely.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for remaining MIA RBs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active vs Cowboys after pregame workout looking good; likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout positive; Schefter/Rapoport confirm active.
items.implication: Startable but capped snaps/routes; reverse Bateman/Andrews full bump.
items.opportunity: Monitor actual snap share/routes if limited.

items.text: Late injury watch: Achane knee, Jefferson ankle, Hall quad, Etienne hamstring, Evans rib, Mayfield thumb/McMillan knee, Coker quad, Andrews hand, Spears ankle, Bech forearm.
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated right thumb; MRI tomorrow, likely to miss time.
items.implication: TB QB situation fluid; McMillan also knee.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and skill elevators if multi-week.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make 2026 season debut.
items.why: Confirmed active for debut after knee.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 upside if full role; Mayer handcuff reverse.

items.text: Risky but if Flowers active for Baltimore he's active for me; start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active status overrides prior risk; prefers over Bateman.
items.implication: Start Flowers in fantasy lineups over safer Ravens options.
items.conflict: Levitan had him OUT in early projs.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren and WR Michael Pittman (foot Q, expected) both active.
items.why: Confirmed on actives; Pittman expected per Schefter.
items.implication: Full roles expected; no major downgrades.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell expected inactive (finger); WR depth: Wilson, Isaiah Williams, Pritchett, Shepard, McLain. Expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount.
items.why: Finger; confirmed expected inactive per Fowler.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 with expanded target share; Sadiq hybrid usage.
items.opportunity: High target/route share for Garrett Wilson; Sadiq slot/wide snaps.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected to play vs Chargers; confirmed active.
Zay Flowers (hamstring) out in projections currently; still possible plays, late swap Bateman/Andrews DFS. Moore in (limited), Mitchell out.
items.why: No full info early; team not counting on Flowers.
items.implication: Initial DFS lean Bateman/Andrews; updated post-active.
items.conflict: Later ACTIVE confirmed; Berry start over Bateman.

items.text: AM summary: Flowers GTD (not counting), Spears hopeful; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson/Bagent.
items.implication: Baseline for late updates; many cleared later.

items.text: Raiders WR Jack Bech ruled out, broken forearm, headed to IR (return later season).
Saquon Barkley and Devonta Smith expected to play.
items.implication: Full roles; no major fantasy downgrade.
